card.name: The end of tromethamine in drug names
card.fires_on: The final piece "amine" in "tromethamine", mostly in "ketorolac tromethamine" and also "fosfomycin tromethamine". It also fires once on the end of the word "SCIENCES" in an all-caps list.

modes.label: Tromethamine salt names
modes.description: The closing "amine" of tromethamine after a drug name such as ketorolac or fosfomycin.
